BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Cleveland, Rivers, Takko, Wilson, King, Bailey, Short, Warnick, Honeyford, and Braun

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mosquito control districts; and amending RCW 17.28.257.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 17.28.257 and 1959 c 64 s 9 are each amended to read as follows:Assessments—Payment, lien, delinquencies, foreclosure, etc.
BillSection.P: The provisions of chapters 84.56 and 84.64 RCW and RCW 36.88.120, 36.88.140, 36.88.150, 36.88.170 and 36.88.180 36.29.180 governing the liens, collection, payment of assessments, delinquent assessments, interest and penalties, lien foreclosure and foreclosed property of county road improvement districts shall govern such matters as applied to mosquito control districts.
